titre: Messages financiers échangés chaque jour dans le monde
sous_titre: Moyenne quotidienne, en millions de messages, 2022 à 2025

2022.texte: in 2022 11.3 billion messages were sent with a daily average of 44.8 million messages

2023.texte: In 2023, 11.9 billion messages were sent with a daily average of 47.6 million.

2024.texte: In 2024, 13.4 billion messages were sent, with a daily average of 53.3 million.

2025.texte: In 2025, a total of 15.1 billion messages were exchanged, corresponding to a daily average of 59.7 million messages.
